title: Privacy policy
updated: Last updated: 10 October 2026. Silver Vibe™ is a personal open-source project. Contact

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: When you sign in (email/password, Google, or GitHub via Firebase Authentication), we process account identifiers such as your email address, display name, and Firebase user id. We store a matching user row in our application database so the API can authorize your requests.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: We use this information only to operate sign-in, protect API routes, and provide the product. We do not sell personal data. We do not use it for unrelated advertising.

processors.title: Processors
processors.body: Authentication is provided by Google Firebase Auth. Hosting and related infrastructure may process requests as needed to run the service. Their own privacy terms apply to their processing.

retention.title: Retention & rights
retention.body: Account data is kept while your account exists. You may request access or deletion by emailing

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update this policy as the project evolves. The date above will change when we do. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised policy.
